Requirements Experience At least 2 years Additional Requirements Professional Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Generalist, HR Compliance, or related areas. Good understanding of HR policies, procedures, and employment laws. Experience in HRIS and employee data management. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word. Educational Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field from a reputed university. Responsibilities & Context Role Overview: The HR Operations & Governance Expert will oversee key HR operations, governance, compliance, and HRIS activities across the company. The role will ensure accurate employee documentation and data, smooth contract and settlement processes, regular HR audits, and compliance with company policies and applicable regulations. The role will also analyze employee and organizational data, identify improvement areas, and drive actions to strengthen HR processes and employee experience. Major Responsibilities: Manage employee onboarding documentation and ensure completeness and compliance with company policies and legal requirements. Coordinate employee contract preparation, amendments, and other contract-related activities with relevant stakeholders. Work with the Compensation & Benefits team to ensure accurate and timely employee settlements. Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation across relevant HR systems. Conduct regular HR process audits, identify compliance gaps, and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure HR processes are aligned with company policies, procedures, and applicable employment laws. Administer organizational health and employee surveys, analyze findings, and share key insights with management. Develop action plans based on audit and survey findings and monitor progress. Maintain and regularly update HRIS employee data, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Prepare HR reports and support management with relevant data and insights. Identify opportunities for HR process improvement, standardization, and automation. Support HR projects, policy implementation, and other governance initiatives as required. Responsibilities & Context Reportable to: Executive Director Position Overview: The Accounts And HR Officer play a crucial role in overseeing all financial activities within the organization, ensuring that funds are managed responsibly and effectively. This includes preparing and presenting financial statements, monitoring budgets, and analyzing financial data to ensure proper allocation and use of resources. The Finance and Admin Officer will also manage accounts, payroll, and cash flow, ensuring compliance with financial regulations. Additional responsibilities include mitigating financial risks, managing financial systems and liaising with stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Financial Monitoring and Reporting: Maintain accurate financial records, ledgers, and accounts for the project. Prepare and analyze financial reports, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements. Monitor project expenses and ensure alignment with the approved budget. Allocate staff costs based on timesheets and program cost-sharing percentages. Review payment documents for completeness and accuracy. Prepare financial statements and provide regular updates to Executive Director. Ensure compliance with CEDIO as well as government financial regulations. Budgeting and Forecasting : Assist in the preparation of project budgets aligned with project goals and objectives. Collaborate with project teams to develop financial forecasts and track performance. Identify potential cost overruns and recommend corrective actions. Cash Flow & Risk Management: Monitor project cash flow and manage fund disbursements. Ensure timely payroll processing and fund allocation. Identify financial risks and implement mitigation strategies to avoid overspending or underutilization. Compliance & Audit: Ensure compliance with donor requirements and internal financial controls. Prepare financial documentation for audits and assist in audit processes. Review and approve project expenditures, ensuring adherence to internal controls and procurement regulations. Stakeholder Engagement: Liaise with donors, government authorities, and stakeholders to provide financial updates. Collaborate with program staff to align financial and programmatic objectives. Team Management & Capacity Building: Provide guidance and training to project teams on financial procedures. Foster a learning environment and ensure that all team members understand financial policies and systems. Cash Operations & Bank Management: Process cash withdrawals and ensure timely bank payments. Liaise with bank officials to ensure uninterrupted services. Prepare monthly bank reconciliation schedules and review bank statements. Ensure internal control procedures for all cash disbursements, receipts, and transfers. Payroll and Taxes: Review staff payroll for accuracy and compliance. Ensure that payroll records adhere to financial controls and that payments are legitimate. Supply Chain Responsibility: Collaborate closely with procurement committee to ensure that financial transactions align with procurement and inventory processes. Prepare Purchase Orders (POs) and review Purchase Requests (PRs) to ensure proper coding, budget adequacy, and compliance with donor regulations. Liaise with Program, and Administration departments to ensure seamless coordination in the procurement of goods and services. Other Duties: Assist the Project Officer Or Office Staff in donor report preparation and responding to audit requests. Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation reports. Review Purchase Orders and Requests for budget adequacy and coding. Skills & Expertise Accounts and Finance Bank Reconciliation Budgeting Finance & Bank Operation Financial Analysis Supply Chain and Procurement
